note.en: Fixed MIPI-DSI panel (480x800 ST7701S) driven over the DSI PHY; the high-speed lanes are dedicated DSI pins, not GPIO-mappable, so only reset (PB0) and backlight (PB1) are listed. The board Kconfig selects ENABLE_DISPLAY / ENABLE_MIPI_DSI, so the panel is part of the board definition rather than an application choice.
note.zh-CN: 板载固定 MIPI-DSI 屏（480x800 ST7701S），经 DSI PHY 驱动；高速差分对为专用 DSI 引脚，不可映射到 GPIO，故仅列出复位（PB0）与背光（PB1）。板级 Kconfig 自动 select ENABLE_DISPLAY / ENABLE_MIPI_DSI，面板属于板级定义而非应用选项。

name.zh-CN: 片上音频（外置 LTK5313 功放）

note.en: Opt-in via ENABLE_MEDIA (platform default n). On-chip ADC/DAC, 16 kHz mono, AEC disabled. Two onboard differential mics are wired, but capture keeps ADC1/MIC2 only because ADC0 measured near-silent and opening both trips the vendor ADC channel check. PE15 drives the LTK5313 enable through an inverting stage: low = muted, high = playing.
note.zh-CN: 需通过 ENABLE_MEDIA 显式开启（平台默认 n）。片上 ADC/DAC，16kHz 单声道，未启用 AEC。板载两路差分麦克风，但采集仅保留 ADC1/MIC2：ADC0 实测近乎无信号，且同时打开两路会触发厂商 ADC 通道检查。PE15 经反相级驱动 LTK5313 使能：低为静音，高为播放。

note.en: K1 is an ADC-ladder key on PD00 (ADC0 channel 0), registered through the Tuya ADC-button TDL; raw pressed range 0-96. It is not a digital GPIO input.
note.zh-CN: K1 是 PD00（ADC0 通道 0）上的 ADC 分压按键，通过 Tuya ADC 按键 TDL 注册；按下原始值范围 0-96，并非数字 GPIO 输入。

note.en: Optional CAM2 DVP0 module on the J49 SEN_FPC connector. The board Kconfig defaults to BOARD_CAMERA_NONE, so the camera TDD driver exists but is not enabled by default. Wiring from the platform camera staging: IIC SDA PE7 / SCL PE8 (hardware IIC1, or software IIC1 device iic4 when JIELI_BOARD_CAMERA_DVP_SW_IIC1=y), XCLK PD8, RESET PE9, PCLK PE3, VSYNC PE4, HSYNC PE5; PE6 gates the baseboard 1.8 V/2.8 V camera LDOs. The 10-bit data bus (PD9-PD15, PE0-PE2) is not listed because the board schema only defines d0-d7 and the source does not state the lane order. A CAM1 MIPI-CSI2 (SC1346) connector is an alternative this schema cannot express.
note.zh-CN: J49 SEN_FPC 连接器上的可选 CAM2 DVP0 模组。板级 Kconfig 默认 BOARD_CAMERA_NONE，因此摄像头 TDD 驱动虽存在但默认未启用。引脚来自平台 camera staging：IIC SDA PE7 / SCL PE8（硬件 IIC1；置 JIELI_BOARD_CAMERA_DVP_SW_IIC1=y 时改用软件 IIC1 设备 iic4）、XCLK PD8、RESET PE9、PCLK PE3、VSYNC PE4、HSYNC PE5；PE6 控制底板 1.8V/2.8V 摄像头 LDO。10 位数据总线（PD9-PD15、PE0-PE2）未列出，因为板级 schema 仅定义 d0-d7，且源码未给出 lane 顺序。另有 CAM1 MIPI-CSI2（SC1346）连接器，本 schema 无法表达。
